description:
Sequentially numbered invoice/receipt documents for orders (gapless numbering — feeds the NF525 profile later); agency/B2B accounts with pay-later reservations, due dates, partial payments, dunning. Completes TKT-4's group/agency reservation story.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Invoice numbering gapless per series; documents localized (TKT-36) and VAT-correct (TKT-32)
- Agency reservation → invoice → (partial) payments reconcile in the journal
- Overdue flow: reminders, hold expiry policy on non-payment

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map). Origin: backlog grilling 2026-07-12.

comments.body: COS defined at epic level; decompose when prioritized (Gate 1). Blind spot found in review: group/agency pay-later existed with no billing counterpart.
